{{Top|leg}}
A '''handheld signaler''' was used to control a [[Marksman-H combat remote]]. It used high-pitched coded bursts to transmit commands to the [[Remote/Legends|remote]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
